svg.title: Rohan & Fangorn
svg.desc: Fangorn borders the northern plains. Isengard is north of the Fords of Isen; Helm’s Deep lies west of Edoras. Entwash branches into Anduin in the east. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The Riddermark, from the Isen to the Great River
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
